title: Design: AccountingHub invoice record lists its No Charge lines
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have AccountingHub enabled.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have an invoiced billable work order of the regular customer with one line marked No Charge, Warranty, made for this test.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow5-05-3c-accountinghub-invoice-record-with-one-no-charge.png, iwo-happy-44-41b-accountinghub-invoice-record-with-one-no-charg.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open Accounting > Sales > Invoices.
  2. Open the invoice's record.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list opens.

Step 2:

  • The record carries a "No Charge lines" block with the line, category, original work order, original technician, hours and parts cost, fully visible.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11765 (Story 8, AccountingHub, the closed work order and its parts cost), story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S8-R7: “An invoice of a billable work order with no-charge lines (Story 12) reaches the hub as an ordinary invoice record with its revenue and receivable on the billable lines.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
